hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Each array element must satisfy two conditions: its digit sum matches the specified target, and elements are non-decreasing.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Precompute all possible integer values up to a practical bound that have the target digit sums.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Transition the count of valid non-decreasing sequences element by element modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterates through candidate values bounded by max_val v.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all non-decreasing sequences directly leads to exponential runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains transition dictionary of length at most v.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines digit sum filtering with sorted sequence dynamic programming.
